name: causalontology/causalontology
description: The PHP binding of the Causalontology standard - a verb-first noun-hosting ontology; reified causation as a programming-language-neutral standard and shared commons. Bundled extensions only; zero Composer dependencies.

extra.license-name: The attribution always; no profit, no problem license. (Apache License 2.0 text)
extra.no-version-field: Deliberately absent. Packagist publishes this package from the repository-ROOT composer.json and takes every version from a git tag (v4.0.0 ... v4.0.3, latest v4.0.3), so a hardcoded version here would be a second, unpublished, and immediately stale declaration - it read 4.0.0 while the registry served v4.0.3. Composer's own guidance is to omit the field for any package distributed through a VCS. This manifest exists for local `composer install`/`composer test` inside bindings/php only.
extra.vendored-schemas: spec/schema/ holds a byte-for-byte copy of the repository's twenty-one spec/schema/*.schema.json files. SchemaValidator prefers it over any repository-relative path, so an installed copy validates with no repository present. It is data, not PSR-4 source, so nothing in the autoloader references it: keep archive.exclude empty and add no .gitattributes export-ignore covering spec/, or the installed package silently loses the ability to validate. bindings/php/conformance.php fails the run if the copy is absent, incomplete, or byte-different from spec/schema.
